text: The RBA raised its cash rate 25 basis points to 4.85%, an 18-year high, in a 6-3 vote. September CPI rose 4.3% YoY, versus 4% in August. Annual GDP growth slowed from 2.5% in Q1 to 2.1% in Q2. Inflation remains above the 2%-3% target range.

meta.note: The rate decision was split; the inflation target remains unmet.
